_comment: Strategist input (design 3.1). tag: country tag; start_date: a bookmark date (YYYY.M.D); goal: the user's words, verbatim; goal_clarifications: later user answers, verbatim; mode: fair (default) or meta, chosen by the user; dlcs and mods: auto (read the launch configuration) or explicit lists; horizon: the last date the plan covers; player: the role that plays from the brief (model and effort come from config.json agents); lessons: the lessons file.
